info.title: varve
info.description: Varve: the server and the varve command line. An event-sourced RDF store with SPARQL 1.1 Query, Update, Graph Store Protocol and a change feed over HTTP.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Plan and apply management declarations as code (ADR 0163).

options.name: --server
options.description: The server's address; its /manage/ resources are used.

options.name: --plan
options.description: Print the plan and apply nothing.

options.name: --out
options.description: Save the plan to this file, to apply later with --from-plan.

options.name: --exit-code
options.description: With --plan, exit 2 when the plan would change something: the drift check.

options.name: --from-plan
options.description: Apply a saved plan; refused when an owned graph moved since it was made.

options.name: --from-config
options.description: Print the TriG that replaces a configuration file's Varve:Datasets and Varve:Auth:Datasets, and its bootstrap operators.

options.name: --token
options.description: A bearer token for the management audience; VARVE_TOKEN when absent.

options.name: --authority
options.description: The OIDC issuer to obtain a token from.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: The OIDC client.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: The client's secret; VARVE_CLIENT_SECRET when absent. Prefer --client-assertion.

options.name: --client-assertion
options.description: Workload identity federation: a file holding the platform's token, or 'github' for GitHub Actions' OIDC token.

options.name: --assertion-audience
options.description: The audience GitHub Actions' token is asked for; api://AzureADTokenExchange by default.

options.name: --scope
options.description: The scope to ask the issuer for: the management audience's.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: files
arguments.description: TriG files of management declarations; each owns, whole, every graph it names.

commands.name: lease
commands.description: Inspect a dataset's lease or writer epoch; clear a stale owner file, or take an epoch over (ADRs 0116, 0136).

options.description: Remove the owner file when the lock proves free; refuse when it is held.

options.name: --take
options.description: Object store: take the writer epoch over from the epoch --epoch names (ADR 0136).

options.name: --epoch
options.description: The epoch --take takes over from, as varve lease shows it.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the server (ADRs 0101, 0115). Configuration comes from the files, then the environment, then the command line, later winning; an unknown key refuses to start.

options.name: --datasets-root
options.description: The directory file datasets live under (Varve:DatasetsRoot).

options.name: --record-bootstrap
options.description: As the system writer, record the configured Varve:Manage:BootstrapOperators, replacing the recorded ones: an explicit system commit (ADR 0163 point 7).

options.name: --auth-mode
options.description: Oidc or Anonymous (Varve:Auth:Mode).

options.name: --anonymous
options.description: Shorthand for --auth-mode Anonymous: development only (ADR 0037).

options.name: --authority
options.description: The OIDC issuer (Varve:Auth:Authority).

options.name: --audience
options.description: An audience a token may carry (Varve:Auth:Audiences). Repeatable.

options.name: --urls
options.description: What to listen on, as ASP.NET Core takes it; http://localhost:5000 by default.

options.name: --config
options.description: A configuration file, read below the environment and the command line. Repeatable, in order.

options.name: --set
options.description: Any setting as Key=Value under Varve:, as Limits:QueryTimeout=00:01:00. Repeatable.

options.name: --print-config
options.description: Print the effective configuration with secrets redacted, validate it, and exit.
